requirements.text: her case HRC0000712 ... get the priority changed to critical. Kindly update it and move it to work in progress accordingly as it is already assigned to an agent
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case WHERE hr_case_id = 2 AND priority = 'critical' AND status = 'work_in_progress' AND assigned_to = 12
assumptions: HRC0000712 is hr_case 2 (seed: status ready, priority high, assigned_to 12 Samantha Stone, an active agent); opened_for 7 is Denise Hawkins, so the caller is the case's subject
ready -> work_in_progress is a valid transition under policy 3.3 and needs assigned_to not null, which the seed satisfies
assigned_to = 12 is kept as the benchmark tests it: 'already assigned to an agent' asks for no reassignment
the acting user Robin Monroe (user 31) is a manager, who may override priority settings (policy 2)
disagreement: sql: B adds number = 'HRC0000712' beside the anchor, A does not; dropped because number is a server-kept column that is never a cell and the anchor fixes the row

requirements.text: provide a relevant knowledge article on New Hire that we shall be using for the resolution of the case
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case_knowledge WHERE hr_case_kb_id = 13 AND hr_case_id = 2 AND knowledge_id = 2 AND used_as = 'applied'
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (13 after 12); the task creates one link
'New Hire' matches one article, knowledge 2 'New Hire Orientation', state published (linkable under policy 4.2)

used_as = applied kept from the benchmark check: policy 4.2 gives 'applied' to an article linked by hand by HR staff during troubleshooting, which this is; 'suggested' is reserved for the automated search at case creation, and 'resolution' for an article holding the final resolution steps or created after resolution, while the case is only now entering work_in_progress

requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE notification_id = 61 AND hr_case_id = 2 AND email = 'denise.hawkins83@larsonplc.com' AND type = 'update'
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (61 after 60); no reassignment happens, so policy 3.2's alert on assignment is not triggered and this is the only notification
type not stated; the policy's default notification type is update (3.3)

recipient address is Denise Hawkins's user email (user 7), the address the listed lookup tool returns and the benchmark tests; her hr_profile personal_email differs and the seed's earlier notification on this case used it, but no listed tool reads hr_profile
notification.status is not fixed by request or policy and not tested by the benchmark check; left out

requirements.text: move it to work in progress (fulfilment task generated on the move)
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case_task WHERE hr_case_task_id = 150 AND parent_case = 2 AND status = 'draft'
assumptions: implied by the request, not stated: policy 3.2 generates fulfilment tasks when a case moves to work_in_progress, and create_hr_case_task is a listed tool
id assumed next in sequence (150 after 149); the task creates one fulfilment task
status = draft kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy
number is server-kept and never a cell; the seed numbers tasks HRT000xxxx (highest HRT0001148) and no row matches the check's TASK-0001
the linked service (hr_service 2) has no service_template and the case already holds three ready tasks (ids 3-5), so the task's content (short_description, task_type) is undecidable and left untested

Verify Case Task.evidence: number = 'TASK-0001' is dropped: number is a server-kept column that is never a cell, the seed numbers every task HRT000xxxx (highest HRT0001148) and no row matches TASK-%, so the value is whatever the create tool assigns; the task's id, parent case and status are kept

Verify Knowledge (2).evidence: the duplicate of 'Verify Knowledge' on the same row (hr_case_kb_id 13) with used_as = suggested; the two cannot both hold (one row, and the table's unique key on case and article allows one link); policy 4.2 reserves 'suggested' for the automated search at case creation, and this article is linked by hand on an existing case, so 'applied' holds

notes: Merged from two passes that agree on every requirement (case 2 to critical and work_in_progress with assignee 12 kept, link 13 of article 2 as applied, notification 61 of type update to Denise's user email, task 150 in draft on case 2) and on all five dispositions (three kept, the task check repaired by dropping the server-kept number, the second knowledge copy excluded). disagreement: sql of the case requirement: B adds number = 'HRC0000712' beside the anchor; dropped (logged in the requirement). The seed's assignee (user 12) is a member of user_group 3, not the case's assignment_group 5, which breaks policy 3.2's membership rule before the agent acts; the request asks for no reassignment and the benchmark keeps assigned_to = 12, so the file does the same. The case sits in org 2 while its subject (user 7) is in org 3 and the acting user and the article are in org 1; org_id is not tested anywhere, as the benchmark checks ignore it. The task requirement rests on policy 3.2 rather than the request's words; the benchmark tests it and the tool is listed, so it is kept. No stay requirements: the case number, the employee and the article each match one seed row, and the request forbids nothing beyond keeping the assignee, which the case requirement carries. The judgement both passes were least sure of is used_as = applied against resolution.
